summary: rollcall: Codex workers join the chat view - their conversation (replies, commands, diffs, plan, approvals) comes from the Codex app server through `api conversation`, and task.switch flips a Codex task between rollcall's chat pane and Codex's own screen.
why: Lets the cockpit show Codex tasks as a chat like Claude tasks, with the terminal as a fallback.
